content: Project-owned deterministic files only; no user files or Microsoft executable code.

recipes.pattern-multifile: bytes0..255 repeated768 times, then ASCII CAB LZX cross frame and file boundary. plus LF; split at65551 into first.bin and second.bin, then empty.bin.
recipes.mszip-history-multifile: Same deterministic bytes and65551 split as pattern-multifile; independent zlib verifies that later frames cannot decode without preceding32KiB history.
recipes.aligned-multifile: seed=SHA256(LE32(i)) concatenated for i=0..511 (16KiB); for i=0..32767 select seed chunk of64B using SHA256(LE32(i))[0]; split concatenation at65551, then empty.bin.

validation_scope: Known ordinary-file bytes and exercised LZX frame/window/block behavior; complete CAB host-service validation is performed separately.

independent_algorithm_check.scope: Every frame terminates exactly and the full known input matches; later frames require history.
